# Lecturer in Applied Statistics

**Øresund Business Academy** · Copenhagen (hybrid, teaching on campus) · 1 position

We teach 3,000 students business, logistics and data. We are looking for a lecturer to
teach statistics to our data and economics students, and to supervise their projects.

## What you will do

- Teach introductory and applied statistics courses, in Danish and English.
- Supervise final-year projects with companies.
- Develop exercises and exams with your colleagues.

## What we are looking for

- At least 3 years of work with statistics in research or industry.
- Deep knowledge of statistics and statistical modelling.
- Experience teaching, training or supervising.
- R for analysis and teaching.
- Fluent Danish, as most courses are taught in Danish.
- You must be allowed to work in the EU.

## Nice to have

- Experience designing experiments or trials.
- Python, as some courses are moving to it.

We offer a permanent position, time for your own development and long summer holidays.
